central_question: Do matched-null, independent 2D dependency and independent full-cell CRC single-cell analyses support the interpretation that the frozen mixed-marker RNA module chiefly tracks cellular composition, while SCD remains a fitness dependency rather than a demonstrated trogocytosis regulator?

matched_null_gse178341.population: author-annotated tumour cells from the 62 MMR-annotated patients used in V7
matched_null_gse178341.primary_outcome: Spearman rho between whole-tumour frozen-module score and author-annotation-derived T-cell fraction
matched_null_gse178341.module_score: mean of gene-wise z scores from patient-level log2 CPM pseudobulk; invariant genes contribute zero after being recorded

matching_features.mean_expression: log1p(10000 * total tumour-cell UMI for the gene / total tumour-cell UMI across genes)
matching_features.detection_rate: fraction of tumour cells with UMI > 0
matching_features.immune_lineage_specificity: log2((TNKILC pseudobulk CPM + 0.1)/(all other tumour-cell pseudobulk CPM + 0.1))

matched_null_gse178341.eligible_pool: unique non-mitochondrial, non-ribosomal gene symbols detected in at least 0.05% of tumour cells and in at least 10 patient pseudobulks, with non-zero patient-level variance; exclude the frozen module and the full prespecified trogocytosis panel
matched_null_gse178341.matching: robust-z transform each feature; Euclidean nearest-neighbour matching; k=50 primary; one gene per target without replacement within each module
matched_null_gse178341.primary_inference: one-sided empirical P for rho_null >= rho_observed; also report two-sided empirical P, null median, 95% interval, percentile and z score
matched_null_gse178341.failure_rule: If the observed rho is not more extreme than the matched-null distribution, interpret the association as non-specific to the frozen module; if it is extreme, call it unusually T-lineage-coupled but still not an event-level trogocytosis marker.

depmap_scd_vps72.crc_definition: OncotreePrimaryDisease == Colorectal Adenocarcinoma and ModelType == Cell Line
depmap_scd_vps72.raw_model: two-sided Spearman correlation across complete CRC cell lines
depmap_scd_vps72.common_essential_definition: among all 2D lines: >=90% observed values, median Chronos <= -0.5 and >=80% of values < -0.5; remove SCD and VPS72
depmap_scd_vps72.adjustment: rank-transform SCD and VPS72 within CRC; residualize each on genome-wide per-line median, genome-wide per-line MAD and PCs 1-5 of standardized common-essential gene effects; correlate residuals
depmap_scd_vps72.uncertainty: 10000 cell-line bootstrap replicates plus 10000 label permutations
depmap_scd_vps72.replication_success: same negative direction as the frozen organoid QC-adjusted estimate, adjusted two-sided P < 0.05 and bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero
depmap_scd_vps72.failure_rule: Any other result is not an independent replication; positive association is directionally discordant and must not be called co-dependency.

eligibility_locked_before_results: full-cell tumour atlas containing epithelial and immune compartments
public UMI matrix and author cell annotations
gse132465_replication.whole_tumour_score: same frozen eight-gene, gene-wise-z mean score from patient pseudobulk log2 CPM
gse132465_replication.epithelial_score: same score within author-annotated epithelial cells; invariant genes contribute zero and are recorded
gse132465_replication.primary_test: two-sided Spearman correlation of whole-tumour score with T-cell fraction, with 10000 patient bootstrap replicates and 10000 permutations
gse132465_replication.secondary_test: same correlation in epithelial-only pseudobulk and paired-bootstrap attenuation |rho_all|-|rho_epithelial|
gse132465_replication.strong_replication: rho_all > 0 with P < 0.05 and attenuation > 0.20 with bootstrap 95% CI above zero
gse132465_replication.compatible_replication: rho_all > 0 with P < 0.05 and point attenuation > 0.20 even if its CI includes zero
gse132465_replication.failure_rule: If whole-tumour coupling is absent or epithelial restriction does not attenuate it, do not claim cross-cohort replication of composition tracking.

integration_gate: Integrate into V8 if at least two analyses are interpretable and materially clarify the central boundary, regardless of whether their results are positive or null; all interpretable prespecified outputs remain in the supplement.
claim_ceiling: E2 association for cross-cohort composition tracking; E1 platform replication for DepMap; no event-level, causal or treatment-efficacy claim.
